findings.quote: neither gave them up nor allowed it; they warned those present
findings.problem: Greek is οἱ δ᾽ οὔτ᾽ ἔδοσαν, προεῖπόν τε τοῖς παροῦσιν: they did not give (the bodies) and (te) warned those present. There is no second negated verb 'allowed it'; the English invents one and splits the sentence wrongly.
findings.proposed_fix: did not give them up, and they warned those present

units.note: Ends mid-sentence in the Greek (ἐν | τούτοις ἦν in ch. 83); the [...] marker is correct.
Greek has active τὸν ... ἐπαναγαγόντα for Hanno (text possibly doubtful); English 'was now brought back into command' gives the evident sense, left unflagged.
